analysis: Market regime: SPY uptrend with modest positive slope (+0.24% 20d). Portfolio is performing well overall — 4 of 5 positions are solidly in the green (ADSK +9.9%, UHS +12.3%, ULTA +10.2%, FOXA +6.5%), and no position is triggering stop concerns. AMP (-3.40%) is the one to watch: it is not in today's screened universe, is slightly underwater, and wealth-management stocks face rate-sensitivity headwinds. Thesis is not broken (no stop hit), but I'll flag it for reassessment if it drifts below ~$510 or if fundamentals deteriorate. At 5 positions and 75% deployment we are at the upper bound of our 3-5 target. Remaining headroom is ~$20k (95% gross cap). Most screened candidates are either too extended in their 52-week range (REGN 89%, TXN 90%, UNH 86%, CVX 80%), too far above SMA50 without basing (NXPI +12.8% above SMA50), or in energy with deteriorating EPS trends (EQT -15.1% revision, APA/VLO high volatility). One genuinely asymmetric setup stands out: TEL (TE Connectivity). It is in a confirmed uptrend, sits at the midpoint of its 52-week range, is only modestly extended above SMA50 (+3.9%), has strong and accelerating EPS revisions (+5.5%), excellent quality metrics, and fair valuation. This is the only setup that clears all three bars: quality business, fair price, trend not going down. All other candidates either lack technical confirmation, are overextended, or carry negative estimate momentum. Cash held in reserve remains a valid posture; we are adding one position only because TEL is genuinely asymmetric within our remaining headroom.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $220 or better; acceptable up to $222 on intraday pullback to SMA intraday support. Do not chase above $224 — wait for next dip if missed.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: TE Connectivity is a high-quality industrial/technology connector manufacturer with ROE of 24.6%, operating margin of 21.1%, and revenue growth of 11.9%. Forward P/E of 14.49 and PEG of 1.26 represent fair-to-attractive pricing for a compounder of this quality. FCF of $2.4B and operating CF of $4.5B confirm durable cash generation. Critically, analyst 1-year EPS revisions are +5.5% over the past 60 days — one of the strongest revision trends in today's screen, indicating the earnings trajectory is improving. Demand for connectors is structural (EVs, industrial automation, data center build-out). TECHNICAL: Price is in a confirmed uptrend at exactly the 52-week range midpoint (50%), with SMA50 slope positive (+1.2%) and price only 3.9% above SMA50 — not extended. The 'uptrend extending' classification reflects recent momentum but the range position prevents this from being a late-cycle chase. With the 52-week high at $246.32 as a nearer waypoint, there is a clear path to our $260 target on continued trend extension. This combination of improving fundamentals and favorable technical positioning is rare in the current screen.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) weekly close decisively below SMA50 (~$212 area) on volume, indicating trend failure; (2) EPS estimate revisions turn negative >3% over a 30-day period (thesis break); (3) price fails to hold above $210 after any test of that level; (4) holding period exceeds 9 months without reaching target — reassess thesis at that point. Take partial profits (~50% of position) at the 52-week high of $246 to lock in gains and reduce risk on remaining shares riding to $260 target.
